description: Retrospective rank reanalysis; raw experiment results untouched. Rank score=(players-rank)/(players-1), equal-strength50%. Primary aggregate averages player counts equally; game-weighted alternative also reported. Whole-seed percentile bootstrap, six seeds. Family9 interval uses alpha=.05/9 as sensitivity only; does not undo post-hoc metric selection.
